versions.changelog:
**v2.3 introduces Claude API smart polish and platform compliance rewriting.**

- Added `claude_polish.py`: Use Claude API for intelligent prompt refinement and professional artistic rewrites.
- Added `safety_lint.py`: Detects and rewrites prompts with terms easily blocked by SD/MJ/DALL-E for compliant artistic usage.
- Now provides a "six-in-one" toolkit: prompt enhancement, video prompt, reference prompt reverse-engineering, direct image output, intelligent polish, and safety/compliance rewriting.
- Supports new collaboration by chaining Claude/GPT/Gemini AI tools for improved prompt quality and compliance.
- All core scripts and docs updated to integrate and describe the new polish and safety features.

**v2.2 introduces video prompt enhancement, reverse prompt, and direct image rendering for a complete T2I/T2V prompt toolkit.**

- Added enhance_video.py for text-to-video prompts with 9 model presets (Sora/Kling/Runway/Pika/Luma/Hailuo/即梦/Wan), 30 camera motions, and keyframe segmentation
- Added reverse_prompt.py for automatic prompt extraction from reference images (A1111/ComfyUI/NovelAI metadata, VLM fallback)
- Added render_prompt.py to render prompts directly with ComfyUI, SD-WebUI, or DALL-E backends; supports dry-run
- Image prompt (enhance_prompt.py) now supports arbitrary style preset mixing: `-p A+B --mix 0.6`
- Unified and extended prompt consistency "locks" to video (now includes camera, lighting, palette, aspect, seed, motion)
- Documentation and skill description updated to reflect multi-modal, all-in-one workflow

- Initial release of huo15-img-test: a skill to enhance text-to-image (T2I) prompts.
- Converts simple user descriptions into professional, structured prompts compatible with major T2I models (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Flux, etc.).
- Supports 17 built-in style presets (photography, anime, architecture, ink painting, and more).
- Users can interactively request prompts or run scripts directly with various parameters.
- Provides advanced output options, including preset listing and JSON format support.
